title: troia-ics: Provocation Testing for Dormant Supply-Chain Triggers in Industrial Control Systems — code and dataset
description: Code, container definitions, and full experimental record (40 main runs + 40 killer-demo runs) accompanying the IEEE Access manuscript 'Pre-Deployment Provocation of Dormant Supply-Chain Triggers in Industrial Control Systems'. Includes OpenPLC v3 program with hidden contextual trigger, four observability-channel collectors, Isolation Forest and rule-based (2-sigma, 3-sigma) detectors, pre-registered killer-demo analysis pipeline, and all aggregated CSV summaries.
